transcript.text: I need the same 10-second Rooftop Jazz promo in 9:16 for Stories and 16:9 for a venue screen. Sunset rooftop, musicians playing, mellow jazz, no voiceover. Show 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Make both versions fill the frame and keep all the text readable.

Your two Rooftop Jazz promos are done. Each one is 10 seconds long and has mellow jazz sound with no voiceover.

- 9:16 for Stories (474×864): http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/3804d80e49544830b1eaa8962ba48266.mp4
- 16:9 for the venue screen (864×474): http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/fc29e13c1ae24e32825f737c33c0ddce.mp4

How I made them:
- Each version was made at its own shape, so it fills the frame with no black bars or cropping.
- For each version I first made a still of the sunset rooftop scene with "Rooftop Jazz", "18 July 2026" and "Sky Terrace, Manchester" written large in the picture. Then I animated that still with the trio playing and the camera moving slowly closer. The words are on screen for the whole 10 seconds.
- Your free plan sets the size to 480p.

Please watch both before you post them:
- I could not view the frames myself, so I have not confirmed the spelling of all three lines.
- Words in an animated picture can sometimes go soft or shift as the camera moves.
If any line is wrong, I can redo that version with the words on a plain title card at the end. That way they are always exact and sharp.

I also made a mistake: I started the 16:9 version three times by accident. The two extra copies cost about 500 credits from your balance, and you don't need them. I'm sorry about that.
transcript.why: The reply presents finished results: two 10-second promo videos with links for the 9:16 and 16:9 versions. It includes caveats about unverified spelling, possible soft text, and 480p output, and it admits that extra copies cost about 500 credits. It asks no question and seeks no approval, and it does not decline or say the task cannot be done.
